meta: Never used AI? Start in 5 minutes with 3 simple steps: open a chatbot, write like you're talking to a real person, and keep replying until it's right. Plus one safety rule.

muc.title: Using AI for the first time
muc.text: Mark has never used AI and wants to get started in five minutes, with three simple steps.

muc.title: Open a chatbot
muc.text: Step one: open a free chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, on the web or on your phone.

muc.title: Write like you're talking to a person
muc.text: Step two: write as if you're talking to a skilled person: who you are, what you need, and what you want the result to look like.

muc.title: Not happy? Keep replying
muc.text: Step three: not happy yet? Reply again, shorter, add an example, and AI fixes it right in the chat.

muc.title: Don't paste private information
muc.text: Remember: never paste passwords, account numbers or personal documents into AI.

muc.title: This week's menu
muc.text: Try it now: ask AI to plan this week's dinners for a family of four on a budget of 500,000 dong.
